sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Loads the icons, the store, the small building blocks, the goal card, the create popup, the progress dashboard, the review tab and the horizon type.
sections.why: Brings in every part the page combines.

sections.name: GoalsView (part 1)
sections.title: Page state, filter and tabs
sections.what: Reads goals from the store, keeps the chosen tab, horizon filter and popup state, filters the goal list by horizon, and draws the header with the three tab buttons.
sections.why: Holds the page's choices so the right view and filter are shown.
sections.watch_out: The tab count always uses all goals, not the filtered goals.

sections.name: GoalsView (part 2)
sections.title: Create button and page body
sections.what: Draws the Create Goal button, then shows either the progress dashboard, the review tab, or the horizon buttons with the goal grid and an empty message. Finally includes the create popup.
sections.why: Switches the page body based on the selected tab.
sections.watch_out: Only the goal grid is filtered. The progress dashboard always receives all goals.

summary: The main Goals page with three tabs (a goal grid filtered by time horizon, a progress dashboard, and review rituals) and a Create Goal button.
purpose: Gives the user one screen to see, filter and add all goals.
why: Places the tabs and filters at the top so the user can switch views easily.
how: Reads the goals from the store. Keeps the chosen tab, the chosen horizon filter, and whether the create popup is open. Filters the goals by horizon. Draws the tabs and Create Goal button, then the chosen view. Always includes the create popup.
inputs: All goals from the store, plus clicks on tabs, horizon buttons and Create Goal.
outputs: The goals page. Saving in the create popup adds a goal to the store.
risks: The tab label shows the total goal count, not the count in the filtered view. The horizon filter list must match the horizon values used in the data.
debug: If a goal is missing from a horizon, check its horizon field. If the page is empty, check the goals list in the store.
